title: Uniform asymptotics of hook polynomials outside the unit annulus
author: Walter Bridges; William Craig; Amanda Folsom; Larry Rolen
difficulty_reason: The circle-method decomposition must remain uniform in a complex polynomial parameter, separate all root-of-unity arcs, and prevent cancellation of the dominant theta factor. The nonzero-theta exclusion and minor-arc controls are essential beyond merely applying Laplace’s method to the final saddle integral.
